== Summary ==
Slip “•I Can’t Believe He’s Gone” cut unchanged from page 6 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Virtual Set 21 release sheet, December 2023 edition] (PDF file created 30 December 2023), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (594, 797, 1106, 1081)). Version [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V) (Errata 2)|I Can't Believe He's Gone (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). Not a recreation.
